study: Frozen common-test extension for all v29 and v30 program methods
registration_scope: Registered after development results from v27/v29 and some v30 seeds, before v27 common-test execution or any v29/v30 test inference. This is exploratory: known legacy test-patient overlap remains disclosed. No new checkpoint, threshold, rule or model is selected on this test.
gate: Require the complete v27 author/control/rule selection gate and its independently audited common-test predictions; require all six v29 and all six v30 five-round selections and independent development audits. Check immutable source, original model and rule hashes before inference. Failure or missing prerequisites leave the gate closed.
data: Exactly the v27 case order, 2,422 test visits/890 patients, source features and separate full271/molecular219 ATC-L4 spaces. Full-panel out-of-vocabulary labels remain in recall; molecular exclusions and three empty-target visits follow the original panel. Completed-visit diagnosis/procedure inputs and 27.23% source-row mapping coverage limit interpretation. These are not full-order or prospective six-hour results.
methods: Evaluate every declared v29 seven-arm and v30 fourteen-arm method, seeds42/137/2026, all five frozen raw rounds, and proposal-selected checkpoints. Report all original v27 conventional/author/rule main-table methods alongside them. Do not substitute cross-paper reported scores for these executions.
comparability: All methods share test cases, labels and source partition. v29/v30 permanently reserve1,423 of7,115 training patients for witness decisions and fit policies on5,692; v27 methods use their declared training protocols. All consume training-label information but optimization, API and FLOP budgets are not equal. v30 reuses original v29 policy fits; it does not add new fitting exposure. Separate within-v30 gate effects from cross-study changes in witness size and available training patients.
endpoints: Report patient-average drug-set F1/Jaccard, micro precision/recall/F1, predicted set size, empty outputs, source-DDI coverage and known-pair rates, with three-seed means/sample SD. Keep all raw-round and proposal-accepted curves. A raw or accepted per-visit F1 increase/decrease is a descriptive fix/regression, not a clinical safety judgement. There is no saline endpoint or clinician gate.
contrasts: For both proposal-selected and raw-final endpoints: own v29 versus each v29 control; v30 own_C1P1 versus every v30 method; compatibility/confirmation main effects and their interaction within each greedy/own/shuffled family. Also compare selected v29 own and v30 own_C1P1 against every v27 main-table method. Do not select the comparator or report only favorable cells.
uncertainty: Use the existing independently implemented v27 patient-set scorer and4,000 paired patient-cluster bootstrap draws. Average seeds before resampling patients, explicitly conditional on these observed seeds. Report seed SD separately. Intervals are descriptive without multiplicity correction; no universal-SOTA claim follows from an isolated positive interval.
audit: Independent evaluator reexecutes each conditional memory from original models and source features, compares test predictions exactly with saved arrays, reconstructs case identities/labels and regrades scores. Audit all requested state counts and frozen proposal selections. A final table is published only after both the v27 and program-test audits pass. Restricted case identities, probabilities and predictions stay local.
after_test: Report negatives, small effects and regressions. Any further intervention is development work requiring a separately declared untouched confirmation set; these test scores cannot retune this frozen comparison. No API calls are needed for this test extension.
